editorial:
Imagine you are on the run with your partner, feeling like the world is against you. You decide to break into a house and grab a family man as a hostage to help you escape. It seems like a simple plan until you realize the guy you kidnapped is actually a cold-blooded serial killer who just wiped out his own family. Now, you are stuck in a house with the cops surrounding the outside and a monster on the inside. The crazy part is that the couple spends half their time fighting about their own relationship issues while trying not to get murdered. It is a wild mix of high-tension action and dark humor that keeps you guessing.

You will love how the movie flips the script on who the real villain is. The acting is solid and the pacing stays quick, though some of the plot twists might feel a bit sudden. It is a great pick for a movie night if you want something that is not too serious but still exciting.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a final showdown where the couple has to stop working against each other to survive the killer. After a lot of fighting and close calls, they manage to outsmart the serial killer and take him down for good. As the police finally move in, the couple realizes that surviving this nightmare actually fixed their broken relationship. They walk away from the house together, finally free from both the law and the murderer.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves twisted plots and suspense with a bit of humor.
